status: Prepared only; no physical tests performed

tests.method: Record original pad, lip and groove with repeated dimensions and photos before claiming model compatibility.
Compression and recovery across intended low loads, cover stretch, dry/wet friction and conditioned polymer properties; record grade and lot.
Measure release and return force, engagement, pullout, rivet forming and looseness before and after cycles. Choose loads from a reviewed load specification before proof testing.

Repeat stock and candidate seats with several frames. Compare incoming noise separately from outgoing playback. Match measured internal playback level and report uncertainty. Target no worsening against stock outside measurement uncertainty; zero leakage is not assumed.

Draft first screen5000fold/slider cycles,1m drops in6orientations,45C85percentRH24h conditioning. Review fixture and material suitability first. Record damage, latch function and force before/after. Targets are not a standard or demonstrated service life.

Include autistic users in design feedback, allow immediate removal and record individual heat, pressure, texture, sound and stop reasons. No universal comfortable force or acceptance score is assumed.
